mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.sort_order, c.create_time, c.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM article a WHERE a.category_id = c.id AND a.deleted = 0) AS article_count FROM category c WHERE c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
